content:
Priya: Good morning everyone. Today we need to discuss progress on the notification system for the TaskFlow platform.

Rohan: I have already started working on the backend service for sending task reminders. I will finish the API endpoints for notifications and push the code to the repository by Thursday.

Priya: That sounds good. Sneha, once Rohan completes the API, please add the notification panel in the dashboard so users can see reminders for their tasks.

Sneha: Sure. I will design the notification component and integrate it with the backend API by Friday.

Karan: I will also configure the email notification service so that users receive reminders for upcoming deadlines.

Priya: Great. Please make sure the email service is connected to our staging environment before the end of the week.

Meera: After the notification feature is ready, I will test both the dashboard notifications and email alerts to make sure everything works properly.

Priya: Perfect. Also, we need documentation for the notification API. Rohan, please prepare the documentation and upload it to the project repository by Friday.

Rohan: Okay, I will add the API documentation along with usage examples.

Priya: Excellent. Let’s try to complete all these tasks before the next sprint review meeting.

Kuppili Murty will ask Ash to send the drafted and changed email that should be triggered from the Java admin, and post the prepared content in the j noa integration chat group after the mail is triggered.
Kuppili Murty will follow up on the fourth part regarding volunteers required for the Jade Nova on the A part and talk to Chaitanya about finding a full-time senior resource for the AI project.
Bhagyashri Kolhe will mark the time based filter requirement for top 10 customer engagement as 'Cancelled' or 'On hold' because it was not implemented.
Bhagyashri Kolhe will check the backlog requirements, specifically the customer prospect requirement, and find the requirements for 'document management strategy' which was mentioned by Raja.
Priyadarshani Kalbandhe and Atharv Botre will immediately remove the IP solutions category and related options from the activity submission area because it is a critical issue, first testing the changes on UAT and then implementing them on production.
Bhagyashri Kolhe, Atharv Botre, and Priyadarshani Kalbandhe will update the weekly pulse email template by (1) showing the last week's date range, (2) removing 'TL loops', (3) centering 'ID8 Solve', (4) increasing the size of the top box to keep 'so far' in one line, and (5) increasing the height and size for the bars in the five week trend section.
The group will implement a method to show the SL leader name in the list view, either in the next stage action column or a new column, to show who is the owner of the action for every status.
